verses.1: After that, Elohim opened His mouth and scolded Yomō.
verses.3: The day of birth will be destroyed by it, and in the night, it will say, “Hoorah!”
verses.4: Today, it will be dark. The Lord will call them from above, and no river will flow over them.
verses.5: May darkness and shadowyness be upon him; may clouds cover him, just as the bitter days do.
verses.6: This night will take him away from Al-Yihad during the months of the year. He won’t be able to return until after those months have passed.
verses.7: See, this night will be a time of darkness; no noise or disturbance shall occur during it.
verses.8: They will be regarded as a source of terror for those in the days to come.
verses.9: They will be like the stars that shine in the darkness, and they will not be seen in the eyes of those who are blind.
verses.10: For he did not shut the doors of my womb, and he hid all my labors from my eyes.
verses.11: Why did I not find true happiness from the beginning? I left that place, and now I’m alone.
verses.12: Why do they bless me first? And what’s the meaning of those blessings? Because I am not…
verses.13: Now that I’ve laid down, and I’ve rested, then let me sleep peacefully.
verses.14: With kings and rulers of the land, they caused destruction everywhere.
verses.15: Or with golden feathers, which filled their bodies with gold.
verses.16: Or like a hidden cloud, I will not be seen as a person who has never seen light.
verses.17: There, the wicked stopped causing trouble. There, the sources of strength will be restored.
verses.18: Together, those prisoners who were held captive did not hear the sound of the chains being broken.
verses.19: Both young and old, he was there, a free man who sought his own way.
verses.20: Why should one give light and life to those who are dead?
verses.21: Those who wait for death, but he is not there. They search him among the ruins.
verses.22: The happy ones will be Elie-Gil Yashishu, because they will find a place to dwell.
verses.23: For the one whose path was hidden, God will reward him.
verses.24: For before my tears, I shall weep, and they will flow like rivers of tears.
verses.25: For I was afraid, and I trembled. And what has caused my fear will come upon me.
verses.26: I did not sleep, nor did I rest. Then Rogez came.
